thread:
Priya: Noticed another README drift during a workshop. The Dockerfile sample in onboarding shows `ENV REDWOOD_KEY` and an example entrypoint that doesn't export the var on Windows. New users on Windows containers hit a subtle auth failure.
Priya: Problematic Docker snippet:
```Dockerfile
FROM node:20
ENV REDWOOD_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY
COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```
Priya: Two issues: env var name mismatch (REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_KEY) and the `ENV REDWOOD_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY` copy/paste assumes shell expansion which doesn't work in all build contexts.
Owen: Oh nice catch. Where is this?
Priya: docs/onboarding/docker/README.md lines ~8-20. Also the sample entrypoint suggests `set REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` which is Windows CMD syntax; but our CLI examples use `export` in most docs. Confusing for folks on Windows.
docs-bot: Lint: detected env variable inconsistencies and non-portable Dockerfile ENV usage in docs/onboarding/docker/README.md. Rule: docs-docker-env-2026-03-23.
Sierra: Proposed fix: change Dockerfile to explicit ENV name and no shell expansion: `ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY=""` and document passing the build ARG or run-time env. Example run: `docker run -e REDWOOD_API_KEY=$REDWOOD_API_KEY redwood-sample`. Add a short Windows note showing PowerShell syntax: `$Env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "..."` or use `-e` flag.
Marco: Also add a tiny CI snippet check to samples/verify-snippets.sh that parses Dockerfile ENV lines and flags `$VAR` expansions or mismatched names. Quick PR then.
Owen: I'll open PR to update the Docker README, normalize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, add the Windows/PowerShell note, and add the Dockerfile static check in samples/verify-snippets.sh.
Priya: Thanks. Small ask: could we add a one-liner to CONTRIBUTING.md recommending authors test examples locally on Linux and Windows (or at least include both shell and PowerShell forms)? New contributors keep copying only the POSIX form.
Owen: Will do. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/963 - updates Dockerfile sample, normalizes env var, and adds verifier rule.
docs-bot: Preview deployed for PR #963 - snippet-linter report pending. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Priya: Perfect. Once linter passes, can we backfill a short changelog note so search finds "Dockerfile env mismatch"? A few support tickets referenced it.
Marco: Yep, will add changelog entry in the PR. Closing this thread after merge. :white_check_mark:
